title: Welcome
description: server -> device, replies to hello once the connection is accepted (which now means: a valid hello, followed by a successful challenge/challenge_response, per challenge.schema.json). A rejected hello, or a failed challenge, never gets a welcome — the connection is closed with a WS close code instead.

latest_app_version.description: Newest app version the server knows of; the app compares it to its own to decide on an update banner.

minimum_supported_app_version.description: Oldest app version the server still supports; an older app shows a blocking update screen.
